_notes.slug: Short public name, lowercase, hyphens. Example: peace-of-mind-hvac. Do not add the random suffix yourself.
_notes.preview_suffix: Leave empty. The generator assigns 4 characters, stores them here, and reuses them when you rebuild.
_notes.category: hvac, plumbing, salon, or barber. Anything else becomes generic. Sets default services, quote vs booking form, and art.
_notes.tagline: Optional hero headline. If blank, the category headline is used.
_notes.services: Optional list of {name, detail, price}. If omitted or empty, the category defaults are used. price may be an empty string.
_notes.hours: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun. A range such as 8:00 AM–4:00 PM, or Closed.
_notes.phone: Shown on the click-to-call links. Ten digits become tel:+1….
_notes.service_area: Used instead of a street address. The map is a drawn placeholder, not an embed.
_notes.colors: primary and accent as #hex. The generator picks text color on those fills for contrast.
_notes.logo_url: Optional file name in this folder, such as logo.png. http links are ignored.
_notes.photo_urls: Optional list of file names in this folder. If empty, the page uses a monogram and SVG art.
_notes.website_note: One short line under the concept-preview footer.
_notes.timezone: Optional. Defaults to America/Denver for the open/closed line.

website_note: Replace this with a one-line note about what the preview is based on.
